title: Why grow?
coreMove: A right-sized company treats size as a design choice, adding people or layers only when they strengthen the work more than they slow it.

exampleSpecs.stakes: hire for real strain rather than staff-count prestige
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist measures whether new headcount strengthens the work

exampleSpecs.stakes: separate client value from visible bigness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist treats size as a design choice

exampleSpecs.stakes: show when growth is justified by real work pain
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist grows because quality requires it

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid using headcount as a success proxy
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist replaces staff count with useful business outcomes

exampleSpecs.stakes: protect the customer experience from premature scale
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist notices the complexity cost of a bigger footprint

exampleSpecs.stakes: identify whether a new layer helps delivery or feeds structure
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the protagonist inspects communication cost before adding management
